notice: FICTIONAL MOCK CONTENT. The domain, email addresses and legal entity are INVENTED placeholders on reserved example domains and must never render in production. PHASE 1: this record now carries the locale routing configuration, the route table and per-locale navigation. It is the single source of truth for URL construction, hreflang generation and sitemap output.

domain._note: INVENTED. The real domain is unknown and remains blocking for canonical URLs, hreflang, sitemap generation and Search Console. Unknown U-01.

i18n._rootNote: The bare root / is never an indexable page. It issues a 302 (not 301) to /en/ or /ar/ based on Accept-Language, with a cookie override once the user chooses. x-default points at /en/. A 301 would prevent Google from crawling the other locale and would cache the wrong choice in shared proxies. See docs/MULTILINGUAL_SEO_ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.
i18n._segmentNote: Path segments (reviews, brands, work, journal, method) stay in English in BOTH locales. Slugs are per-locale and independently authored. Rationale and the rejected alternatives are in docs/SEO_URL_ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.

routes.gateRule: minimum 5 published reviews in that category and locale
minimum 3 published articles in that category and locale
minimum 3 verified press mentions with live URLs
2+ published reviews of that product in the locale, or 1 review plus a published comparison feature

reservedSlugs._rule: Category segments share a path level with detail slugs, so a review or article slug must never collide with a category key. The validator enforces this.

navigation._primaryNote: Five items plus a Contact call to action and a language switcher. Brands was removed from the primary navigation in Phase 1: it is reachable from every review and from the reviews index, and two of five mock brands do not qualify for a page in at least one locale. Promoting a partially populated section to primary navigation advertises the emptiest part of the site.

seoDefaults._titleTemplateNote: NOT applied to review, journal or work detail pages, whose seo.title fields are already length-optimised and are used verbatim. Applied to index and utility pages only.

defaultTitle.en: Zina Almokri: beauty creator and product testing
defaultTitle.ar: زينا المقري: صانعة محتوى تجميل وتجربة منتجات

defaultDescription.en: Beauty product reviews built on documented testing. Every product worn, timed and photographed on my own skin, with the conditions published.
defaultDescription.ar: مراجعات منتجات تجميل مبنية على اختبار موثق. كل منتج استُخدم وقيست مدته وصُوّر على بشرتي، مع نشر ظروف الاختبار.

phone._note: Deliberately null. A public phone number is an explicit client decision, not a default.

jurisdiction._note: Determines the applicable privacy regime and therefore the required consent behaviour. Blocking for analytics. Unknown U-03.

editorialStandards._note: Proposed standards, not Zina's stated positions. Each must be approved before publication. High-value E-E-A-T assets that belong at a real indexable URL, not in a modal.

en.disclosurePolicy: Every review states its commercial status above the content: bought independently, gifted, or paid. Paid placements never come with agreed verdicts.
en.correctionsPolicy: Errors are corrected in place, with the change and its date recorded in the review update log rather than removed.
en.medicalBoundary: Nothing on this site is medical, clinical or dermatological advice. Persistent skin concerns belong with a qualified professional.
en.aiPolicy: Reviews are written from first-hand testing. Testing observations, photographs and verdicts are not generated.
en.ratingsPolicy: This site does not publish numeric scores. A number makes comparison easy and hides the reason, and the reason is the product.

ar.disclosurePolicy: كل مراجعة تذكر وضعها التجاري أعلى المحتوى: شراء مستقل، أو مُهدى، أو مدفوع. التعاونات المدفوعة لا تأتي أبدا بأحكام متفق عليها مسبقا.
ar.correctionsPolicy: تُصحح الأخطاء في مكانها، مع تسجيل التغيير وتاريخه في سجل تحديثات المراجعة بدل حذفه.
ar.medicalBoundary: لا شيء على هذا الموقع يُعد استشارة طبية أو سريرية أو جلدية. مشكلات البشرة المستمرة مكانها عند مختص مؤهل.
ar.aiPolicy: تُكتب المراجعات من تجربة مباشرة. ملاحظات الاختبار والصور والأحكام ليست مولدة آليا.
ar.ratingsPolicy: لا ينشر هذا الموقع تقييمات رقمية. الرقم يسهّل المقارنة ويخفي السبب، والسبب هو جوهر المراجعة.
